title: Split kcd2 simulate.ts and inventoryIo.ts, reverting two mutually-dependent seams
objective: Bring src/core/simulate.ts (384) and src/lib/inventoryIo.ts (287) under the 250-line cap, and establish that a seam whose halves call back into each other must be abandoned rather than forced.
acceptance_criteria: simulate.ts, simulateTurns.ts, inventoryIo.ts and inventoryHash.ts are each at most 250 lines.
The suite still reports exactly 288 passing tests in 15 files.
Coverage stays at 100% for statements, branches, functions and lines, with the new modules measured.
npm run lint passes with no new suppression and no eslint-disable.
Every name previously exported from simulate.ts and inventoryIo.ts is still exported from the same path, so no importer or test is edited.
search.ts and badgeValue.ts are fully restored, leaving no partial split and no orphan module.
out_of_scope: search.ts and badgeValue.ts, whose halves are mutually recursive.
The kcd2 test files and App.tsx, which are separate commits.
verifier: npm test -- --run (expects exactly 288 passed in 15 files), npm run coverage (100% on all four metrics), npm run lint, and check_file_length.sh.
